name: Random C-Arm View Sampling
definition: A method to generate random camera-to-world view matrices for C-arm X-ray projections by uniformly sampling geometric parameters (SID, AP angle, lateral angle, table SI translation) and converting them to camera coordinates.
summary: Random C-Arm View Sampling generates independent, non-ordered camera-to-world view matrices by uniformly sampling geometric parameters, distinguishing itself from deterministic strategies by producing stochastic views suitable for data augmentation.
